import { Content as GodotReadme } from "../../../../../../../sdks/godot/README.md";

The Godot SDK — a pure-GDScript addon (the engine has no Ed25519 or SHA-512, so it carries its
own) behind the `PolarisKey` autoload, with the drop-in `PKeyBoot` scene and UI kit, updates by
outlet, and packs: `PolarisKey.update.packs` installs `godot.pck` and `files.tree` releases, checks
every `godot.pck` against the same admission list as `pkey release publish` before it commits or
mounts it, and mounts packs at a boot. **A build that ships no content stamp has no packs**: the
documented setup is the stamp at `res://pkey_packs/pkey-content.json` and embedded baselines (each
with its marker) in `res://pkey_packs/`. This page renders `sdks/godot/README.md` whole, so there
is exactly one copy to keep current.
